d:
A single call can send Turtleman into a wildlife situation he never saw coming! From elusive snakes and stubborn turtles to troublesome raccoons and mink, every assignment brings a different animal, a tricky capture and plenty of unpredictable moments. Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, teams up with Neal James to answer unusual calls for animal rescue, wild animal catching and removal.
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 4, Episodes 1, 2, and 3; Season 1, Episodes 3, 6, 13, and 7, on Animal Planet India.
